summary: Straight-line SSE evaluation of the four cubic Hermite basis functions at parameter t, then a weighted blend of two input values (a6, a8) against the tangent basis lanes H10 and H11, storing two floats through the output pointer a4 and returning a4. No guards, no callees. Structurally a twin of CubicSpline but only the H10/H11 combination is emitted.

operations.description: Compute powers of the spline parameter t (a9): the scalar float t is loaded, a1[0] receives t*t (t^2) and a2[0] receives a9*t*t (t^3); both are later broadcast across SSE lanes for the per-lane polynomial.

Evaluate the four-lane cubic polynomial v11 = t^3 * xmmword_5D8A90 + t^2 * xmmword_5D8AB0 + t * xmmword_5D8AC0, with dword_5D8AA0 added as a constant term on lane 0 only. Lane-wise this is the Hermite cubic basis evaluated at t.

Blend the two input doubles a6 and a8 against selected basis lanes: v12 = _mm_loadh_ps(a6) * shuffle(v11, 80) + _mm_loadh_ps(a8) * shuffle(v11, 250). Shuffles select lanes (0,1) and (2,3); because loadh zeroes the low half, lanes 2 and 3 of v12 survive as a6[*]*H10(t) + a8[*]*H11(t).

Store the low two float lanes of v12 + movehl(a3, v12) through the output double pointer a4, writing the two weighted-combination results a6[i]*H10(t) + a8[i]*H11(t) (8 bytes = one double-width write).
Return the output pointer a4 unchanged.
